exposure: Type of healthcare facility (secondary care facilities)
outcome: Frequency of disrespect and abuse practices towards women during facility-based delivery
cohort: 867 pregnant women admitted for childbirth (vaginal and cesarean) at four hospitals in two Mexican states
finding: Direct observation and interviews revealed that 18.8% of women experienced at least one disrespect and abuse event during facility-based delivery, especially at secondary care facilities, highlighting the need for surveillance policies and committees to guarantee violence-free and dignified treatment during delivery care.
